findings.evidence: UI/store commands flow through EngineClient, transports, SimulationEngine, SimulationExecutor, and the descriptor-derived phase schedule.
GAME_PIPELINE_PHASES and GAME_PHASE_DESCRIPTORS both report 58 registered phases through scripts/orphan-audit.ts.
StableAIState, learning, strategic coordination, relationships, distress, personality, and subsystem policies were preserved under src/domains/agents/simulation.
STORE_STATE_VERSION is the existing compatibility boundary; the campaign advances it to 10 and persistenceContract.test.ts guards transient engine fields.
The old scanner hardcoded contract lists and sampled only selected functions; capabilityGraph.test.ts now derives intents, impacts, and phases from source declarations and registries.
Integration coverage now includes intentProductionPath.test.ts through the authoritative collection/resolution path rather than relying only on direct executePipeline calls.
InfrastructureHandler resolves facility upgrades against entityId-owned player or NPC facility maps and records NPC facility investment on the owning StableAIState.
The dormant applyNpcFacilityUpgrade branch was removed; facility behavior now flows through registered NPC intents and InfrastructureHandler.
intentCapabilityWaivers.ts explicitly classifies lifecycle, player-expression, system-mediated, and NPC-world intents instead of forcing impossible symmetry.
Vitest discovers src/**/*.test.ts(x), excludes Playwright specs, and only redirects mirrored test imports when the source file exists.
Root, start, compare, and rival-career route pages moved to src/components/routes while route files remain adapters.
protectedArtifacts.test.ts verifies ignored .jules artifacts, tracked tool directories, and exclusion of generated routeTree.gen.ts.
